EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: PAS/LAND/ACQVI/07/F1/249B/61.
Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4/3/15/2013/VE/48.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as Amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/Servitude which is required for a public purpose;
Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired:

Under mentioned land shown in the surveyor General’s plan of F.V.P. 23, Supplement No. 50, sheet No. 64, situated in the village of Urubokka. Urubokka Grama Niladari Division, Pasgoda divisional Secretary’s division in Matara district southern province.

Lot No. 1576 Name of the Land: Palleweli Kumbura, Pinkumbura alias Urubokke Mahawela; Description: Open bar land; Claimant: Government; Original Claimant: K.K.P. Sriyani Rupasinghe, Indra Abewikkrama, Chaminda Wijesekara, Nandika Wijesekara and some other’s; Extent: 0.0868 Hectare.
Lot No. 1577 Name of the Land: Udaweli Kumbura, Pinkumbura alias Urubokke Mahawela; Description: Paddy field; Claimant: Government; Original Claimant: Dampahala
Gnanaloka thero, G. Gunathilaka and some other’s; Extent: 0.6765 Hectare.
Lot No. 1578 Name of the Land: Udaweli Kumbura, Pinkumbura alias Urubokke Mahawela; Description: Paddy field; Claimant: Government; K.K. Karunawathi; Extent: 0.0640 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at Divisional Secretariat Pasgoda, on the day 18th of November, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 11th of November 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for computation for the said lands/servitude the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
K.N. KAUSHALYA KUMARI, Divisional Secretary, Pasgoda.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Pasgoda. 05th October, 2015. 11-41
